artworks.title: The Killing of Atreus
artworks.description: An Apulian red-figure vase stages the death of Atreus — the Mycenaean king cut down in the feud his own feast had poisoned. The scene closes the circle the banquet opened: the architect of the Thyestean revenge becomes its next corpse. South Italian pottery.

artworks.title: Atreus and Thyestes (Urbino maiolica)
artworks.description: Urbino istoriato ware paints the brothers of Mycenae facing each other across the curse — Atreus and Thyestes locked in the rivalry that will end at a table of forbidden flesh. Renaissance maiolica turns Seneca's horror into a bright ceramic narrative. Tin-glazed earthenware.

artworks.title: The Feast of Atreus and Thyestes
artworks.artist: Václav Jindřich Nosecký and Michael Wenzel Halbax
artworks.description: This Baroque mural at Zákupy Castle stages the Thyestean banquet: Atreus serving his brother the flesh of Thyestes' own children. The painting makes Atreus the host of horror — the king whose revenge taught Europe how far a Mycenaean feud could go. Wall painting, Zákupy Castle.

artworks.title: Atreus Farnese (Speculum Romanae Magnificentiae)
artworks.description: Cort's engraving for Lafreri's Speculum records the so-called Farnese Atreus — a colossal antique statue Renaissance Rome read as the Mycenaean king. The print freezes Atreus as a standing tyrant of marble before the feast that would make his name proverbial. Engraving, Metropolitan Museum of Art.

music.title: Elektra
music.description: Strauss's one-act shocker is the House of Atreus after the feast: Agamemnon's murder, Electra's hatred, and the bloodline Atreus poisoned still screaming in the orchestra.

popCulture.title: Thyestes
popCulture.creator: Seneca the Younger
popCulture.description: Seneca makes Atreus the architect of the revenge banquet — brother served brother's children — the horror-play that taught Europe how far a Mycenaean king could go.

popCulture.title: Oresteia
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus opens the trilogy on the curse Atreus left his sons: Agamemnon returns to the net, and the house that began with a feast ends in trial at Athens.

popCulture.title: House of Atreus
popCulture.description: "House of Atreus" became shorthand for a dynasty that cannot stop killing its own — the feast, the adultery, the revenge cycle named for the king who set the table.
